frequency_question: How often do state supreme courts invalidate a redistricting map when a final ruling is demanded within a tight electoral timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any partisan gerrymandering or state constitutional redistricting challenge brought in a state supreme court where a final decision was rendered within 6 months of an election cycle since 2004. Excludes purely federal court challenges and cases without final rulings.

cases.name: League of Women Voters v. Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
Caster v. Merrill / Allen v. Milligan (Alabama state parallel)

coverage_note: 8 prominent state supreme court expedited redistricting map challenges identified; 6 resulted in invalidation.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively capture every minor state trial court or intermediate appellate decision, focusing strictly on high-court interventions matching the structural friction of an expedited judicial review.
validity_reason: State judicial review frameworks and constitutional standards for redistricting change slowly, typically tied to generational constitutional amendments or major federal precedent shifts.
